gloss: year after an unlucky year; post-calamity year

definitions.gloss: year after an unlucky year; post-calamity year
definitions.explanation: The year immediately following the main unlucky year (本厄) in the yakudoshi cycle. Considered the final year of the calamity period, when bad luck is gradually fading but caution is still advised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後厄|あとやく}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{油断|ゆだん}できない→油断する：25389_yudansuru⟧。
examples.english: This year is my post-calamity year, so I still can't let my guard down.

examples.japanese: {後厄|あとやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was finally relieved when my post-calamity year ended.

examples.japanese: {後厄|あとやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{厄払|やくばら}い→厄払い：22342_yakubarai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}なくなく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Not a few people go for purification even in the post-calamity year, and some spend all three years cautiously.

notes:
Part of the ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ (unlucky year) cycle in Japanese folk belief. The three-year cycle consists of ⟦{前厄|まえやく}→前厄：25748_maeyaku⟧ (pre-calamity year) → ⟦{本厄|ほんやく}→本厄：25008_honyaku⟧ (main unlucky year) → {後厄|あとやく}. Even during {後厄|あとやく}, many people continue to exercise caution, as misfortune is believed to linger.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後厄|あとやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる: for the post-calamity year to end
- {後厄|あとやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧: the year of one's post-calamity period
- {後厄|あとやく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: to be careful even in the post-calamity year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前厄|まえやく}→前厄：25748_maeyaku⟧: pre-calamity year — the warning year before the main unlucky year
- ⟦{本厄|ほんやく}→本厄：25008_honyaku⟧: main unlucky year — the peak of the calamity cycle
- ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧: unlucky year — the general term for the entire system
- {厄明|やくあ}け: end of the unlucky period — when all three years have passed
